title: Virus/Purge, Recurring Credits and Bad Publicity remain narrow and deterministic
steps: Runner installs Virus Program and receives one virus counter.
Corp Purge is legal only with 3 clicks and removes only virus counters.
Runner installs Recurring Chip and uses its recurring credit for a program install.
Recurring credits refresh at Runner turn start without accumulation.
Corp plays Bad Publicity Operation and gains one Bad Publicity.
Runner starts a run and receives a bad-publicity fund equal to Corp Bad Publicity at run start.
Runner spends the fund for a breaker cost and the fund disappears when the run ends.
Replay reproduces the final StateHash and no extra RandomDrawRecords are created.
